fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-11-12 around 16:00 hrs, it was reported that agents of a loan application allegedly contacted the complainant and relatives with abusive messages over alleged dues of Rs. 50,000. Kannan Thangaraj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000206. A person named Yogesh Gopal, associated with the number 9000000376, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The account reference SYN-ACC-100052 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A witness, Uma Bai, reachable on 9000000465, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: a bank transaction reference and digital documents. The account SYN-ACC-100052 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00137, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Recovery agents allegedly sent abusive messages to the borrower and contacts.
fields.Keywords: loan app, harassment, digital document, mobile number, suspect, afternoon, main street, bank reference
